name: harness-marketplace
description: harness — spec-driven development enforcement for autonomous coding agents. Skills guide the workflow, hooks bind the rules, a framework-agnostic engine decides.

plugins.name: harness
plugins.description: Development enforcement plugin: two-phase context injection (resolver + gates G1, G3, G5 and G6), interface shadows via tree-sitter, ADR-compiled decision tables, slice-based build loop with worktree partitioning, four-layer review stack (ensemble sampling and golden replay are opt-in via review.ensemble), and adjudication that converts every human intervention into durable substrate. Includes the init, architect, design-review, adr-authoring, verification, backlog, build, review, close-slice and harness skills plus 4 agent personas.
